entries.name: 四则二十四
entries.description: 在绿毡算牌桌用四张数字牌各一次，通过有方向的四则运算与精确分数凑成二十四；六道题包含分支组合、百数迂回与必须使用分数的挑战。

entries.description: 自动奔跑穿越天台，抓准时机跳过箱子和缺口，按住下蹲通过悬梁。

entries.description: 穿越车道并借木筏渡河，在有限生命和时间内抵达不同家位。

entries.description: 横移躲避敌弹，持续射击下降编队并使用两枚穿透弹；掩体会损毁，在敌阵越线前清空全部目标。
entries.descriptionEn: Move sideways to dodge hostile fire, shoot descending formations, and use two piercing rounds while destructible cover protects the defense line.

entries.name: 环轨炮台
entries.description: 旋转中央炮台持续瞄准射击，拦截沿轨逼近的目标；两次短时护盾只能吸收接触范围内的来袭者。
entries.descriptionEn: Rotate a central turret and fire at approaching orbital targets, using two brief shields that absorb only enemies touching their range.

entries.descriptionEn: Choose angle and power to navigate obstacles and bank off walls, reaching the cup at low speed within the stroke limit.

entries.name: 王车合围
entries.description: 用白王和白车限制黑王的合法落点，在手数上限内将杀；避免两王相邻、丢车和逼和。
entries.descriptionEn: Use a king and rook to restrict the opposing king and deliver checkmate within the move limit, avoiding adjacent kings, rook loss, and stalemate.

entries.name: 二元织格
entries.description: 填入0和1，使每行每列数量各半、没有连续三个相同数字，且同行与同列各不重复；保留锁定线索。
entries.descriptionEn: Fill zeros and ones with balanced rows and columns, no three identical digits in a row, and no duplicate rows or columns; preserve locked clues.

entries.description: 每区选出四格I、L、T或S形，所有黑格连通且不能形成2×2黑块，相接区域的四格形状必须不同。

entries.description: 布灯照亮全部白格，灯光不能互相照见，并满足每个编号墙的相邻灯数；编辑后手动检查。

entries.description: 每回合先落一子再旋转一个棋盘象限，旋转后连成五子获胜；同时五连与满盘平局需要重试。

entries.description: 观察棋块的气，落子围住对手并率先提满四子；遵守自杀禁入与简单劫，控制手数和停手。
entries.descriptionEn: Read liberties and surround opposing groups to capture four stones first, with suicide prevention, simple ko, and a limited number of turns.

entries.description: 在四列牌与两个暂存位之间逐张搬牌，按异色递减叠放，再按花色递增归位；撤销不退步数。

entries.name: 夜桥接力
entries.description: 在两岸营地安排持灯旅人过桥，每次一至两人、按较慢者计算用时；六支队伍逐步挑战紧凑排程，新增三关需恰好达到最优预算。
entries.descriptionEn: Arrange torch-bearing travelers between two camps, sending one or two people across at the slower pace. Six groups build toward exact scheduling; the three new levels require an optimal total time. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 渡河守则
entries.description: 安排有限船位往返两岸，避免无人看守的冲突组合，用公开规则把所有物品安全运到对岸。
entries.descriptionEn: Plan crossings with limited boat capacity, prevent conflicts on unattended banks, and ferry every item safely across using fully public rules.

entries.description: 在拥挤车阵中沿车身方向逐格挪车，利用有限撤销腾出通路，将目标车辆驶出右侧出口。

entries.description: 选择边线围成方格，利用得格续手掌握回合节奏，与公开规则的对手争夺最后一格。
entries.descriptionEn: Draw edges to complete boxes, keep your turn after each capture, and outscore a public-policy opponent through careful timing.

entries.description: 沿棋穴逐粒播种，利用入仓续手与对穴吃子争取过半种子，并应对规则公开的对手。

entries.description: 在十五孔三角棋盘上，沿六个方向跳过相邻棋珠并移除它，最终只留一珠；管理三次撤回机会，三个不同起始空孔，支持手机扫码单人操作。
entries.descriptionEn: Jump over adjacent pegs in six directions on a fifteen-hole triangular board until only one remains. Solve three different starting vacancies with three limited undo tokens.

entries.name: 石箱归位
entries.description: 在三座庭院里推动石箱，让每个石座都被占据；只能推、不能拉，步行不扣推力，撤回恢复位置但不返还推力。管理有限推动额度，支持手机扫码单人操作。
entries.descriptionEn: Push stone crates onto every socket in three courtyards. You can push but cannot pull; walking is free, while undo restores positions without refunding the limited push budget.

entries.name: 翻面棋局
entries.description: 挑战三道6×6翻面棋残局，用八方向夹击翻转棋子，与确定性电脑对手轮流落子；无合法落点时让行，终局以棋子多数获胜，支持手机扫码单人操作。
entries.descriptionEn: Play three 6x6 Reversi endgames against a deterministic opponent. Bracket and flip discs in eight directions, pass only with no legal move, and finish with the majority of discs.

entries.name: 量杯转运
entries.description: 在三只不同容量的量杯间倾倒，每次必须倒满接收杯或倒空来源杯；保持总水量守恒，在有限倾倒次数内让三杯同时达到公开目标。三个配额关卡，支持手机扫码操作。
entries.descriptionEn: Pour conserved water between three jugs of different capacities. Every transfer fills the destination or empties the source; meet all three visible target amounts within a finite pour budget across three puzzles.

entries.description: 选择染料扩展左上角连通区域，在有限次数内统一全图；只沿四边连通，撤回会恢复地图但不返还染料次数，三张公开地图，支持手机扫码单人操作。
entries.descriptionEn: Flood a connected territory from the top-left corner using a finite dye budget. Four-neighbor expansion, three public maps, and undo that restores the board without refunding moves; phone directional and two action zones.

entries.description: 用单件吊机和三个后进先出的货栈，按公开货单顺序出港；管理有限容量与搬动额度，三次错序出货失败。三个调度关卡，支持手机扫码单人操作。
entries.descriptionEn: Operate a single-cargo crane and three LIFO storage bays to ship visible manifests in order. Three puzzles with finite capacity, limited handling moves and three wrong-order attempts; phone directional and two action zones.

entries.name: 异形装箱
entries.description: 在装箱工作台移动、旋转有限零件，装入六种异形货仓，并保留指定零件的完整直线出库通道；新增中央障碍、多门分流与岔路转运任务。
entries.descriptionEn: Move and rotate a finite set of pieces on a packing desk to fit six shaped containers while preserving straight extraction routes. New jobs add central obstacles, several exit doors and alternative routes. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 万花钥匙
entries.description: 把有限图符摆进源扇区，旋转并选择万花阶数，让整圈镜像钥匙与目标完全一致；核对左右交换、朝向与空格后验收，四次错误即失败，无倒计时。
entries.descriptionEn: Place and rotate limited glyphs in one source wedge, choose a symmetry order, and match the complete mirrored key. Check swapped columns, quarter turns and empty sockets before submitting. Four rejected submissions end the round; there is no deadline.

entries.name: 纹幕校准
entries.description: 滑动并旋转两层周期纹幕，让五个测点的当前明暗同时符合目标；参考可见定位标记，在限时与验收次数内完成三种光学校准。
entries.descriptionEn: Slide and rotate two periodic masks until all five current brightness checks match their targets together. Use visible fiducial guides to complete three optical calibrations within the time and submission limits.

entries.name: 解线工
entries.description: 沿轨道移动接线端子，保持金属线夹整组联动，消除直线电缆的非法交叉与端子重合；三种工作台，最后一次调整也能完成接线。
entries.descriptionEn: Slide terminals along their rails and move linked clamps together to untangle straight cables. Remove illegal crossings and coincident ports across three workbenches; even the last adjustment can complete the wiring.

entries.name: 影形铸坊
entries.description: 旋转金属工件与侧向光源，覆盖全部青色目标格并避开禁区；两种控制独立调整，最后一次机会也能完成铸影。
entries.descriptionEn: Rotate a compact metal assembly and its side light to cover cyan target samples without touching amber forbidden samples. Direction, height and overlap matter; twelve rotations per blueprint.

entries.name: 冰面刹停
entries.description: 左右推动惯性货橇，按住 A 放下冰爪，只有结霜带提供额外制动；完整停入逐渐收窄的交付区并驻留，避开冰面边界和急刹造成的货损。
entries.descriptionEn: Push an inertial cargo sled and hold A to lower the ice claw. Extra braking works only on frost bands. Settle the complete sled inside three narrowing delivery zones while avoiding the edges and cargo damage. Three scenarios; Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 旋环锁匠
entries.description: 左右拨转三层锁环，按住 A 推进、B 退回；进入核心取得钥匙，再将完整钥匙带出，避开碰壁造成的耐久损失和阻力。
entries.descriptionEn: Turn three geared rings, hold A to move inward and B to retreat. Retrieve the core key and guide its wider head back through the gaps while preserving durability. Three locks; Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 节拍闸道
entries.description: 先排方向和等待，按固定节拍穿过周期闸门；在拍数预算内收齐标记并抵达出口，B 可撤回未执行的队尾命令。
entries.descriptionEn: Queue directions and waits, pass periodic gates on each beat, collect all markers and reach the exit within the beat budget. Undo removes only the unexecuted tail command. Three maps; Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 双线节律
entries.description: 一线持续按住，另一线按节拍点按，交替编织并保持连续；完成三个节奏关卡。
entries.descriptionEn: Hold one thread while tapping the other on the beat, alternate roles and maintain continuity across three rhythm charts. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 脉冲储库
entries.description: 按住收集有限脉冲，选择档位向顺序门锁放电；控制储能溢出和热峰，开启四门并保留终储备，完成三种供能关卡。
entries.descriptionEn: Hold to collect a finite pulse supply, select a dose and discharge into sequential locks. Control overflow and heat peaks, open four locks and retain the final energy reserve across three supply scenarios. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 窗口装配
entries.description: 在工厂操作台抓取、旋转并投送零件，趁快门开放完成连续装配；六张工单包含反向传送、窄窗快装与夜班错相协同。
entries.descriptionEn: Grab, rotate and deliver parts through open shutters on a factory console. Six work orders introduce reverse belts, narrow windows and staggered night-shift shutters while requiring consecutive correct assemblies. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 影窗快门
entries.description: 移动取景框并切换横竖画幅，避开遮光纸带，让三片剪影完整入窗并依序拍成目标；用有限胶片完成三组影窗作品。
entries.descriptionEn: Move and rotate the aperture to photograph three complete, correctly aligned silhouettes while avoiding an opaque paper strip. Match ordered targets with limited film across three scenes. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 齿轮同刻
entries.description: 调节齿轮列的离合与制动，在有限调节次数内让所有指针于预约时间窗中持续对齐目标；挑战三种齿比结构。
entries.descriptionEn: Engage or brake gear trains within a limited adjustment budget. Keep every pointer aligned throughout the appointment hold across three gear layouts. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 共振浮桥
entries.description: 调节三块浮桥的频率和相位，派遣行人在持续安全接触时过桥；控制共振增幅，完成三个渡口关卡。
entries.descriptionEn: Tune the frequency and phase of three floating bridge slabs. Dispatch pedestrians who cross only after sustained safe contact, while keeping resonance under control. Three crossing scenarios. Chinese TV interface.

entries.descriptionEn: Allocate reservoir water to residents, farms and the ecological river using four-season forecasts. Undo uncommitted plans, protect seasonal minimums and meet each group's annual target. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 电芯交换
entries.description: 在断电窗口中交换六枚不同电量与内阻的电芯，为两组负载切换串联或并联；按阶段完成供电任务，同时保留电量余裕并避免电芯或负载过热。
entries.descriptionEn: Exchange six cells with different charge and internal resistance during safe off windows. Select series or parallel wiring for two loads, complete their staged power requests, and manage charge and temperature. Simplified circuit game with a Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 装配厨房
entries.description: 安排煮、冷却与装盒三个共享工位并行工作，切换风速掌握温度，在保温时限与关门前按指定顺序交付三份订单；错温、错序或过期的食物会退回重做并累计失误。
entries.descriptionEn: Coordinate shared cooking, cooling and packing stations. Adjust fan speed, manage food temperature and holding limits, and deliver three orders in the required sequence before closing. Incorrect or expired food is discarded and the order returns for rework. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 防火带
entries.description: 用有限行动点提前清理防火带，依据固定变风与累积热量阻断同时蔓延的山火；保护全部村落与至少七成存活森林，清理本身也会减少林木。
entries.descriptionEn: Plan firebreaks with limited action points. Anticipate changing wind and accumulated heat as fire spreads simultaneously, protect every village and retain at least seventy percent of the original forest. Clearing also counts as forest loss. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 气闸值守
entries.description: 在待援舱、气闸与安全舱之间安排三组人员，权衡慢回收保氧和快排赶期限；管理有限储罐与共享泵，及时封堵漏点并满足最终储氧底线。
entries.descriptionEn: Schedule three groups through an airlock. Balance slow oxygen recovery against fast venting and individual deadlines, manage a finite reservoir and shared pump, and seal the leak while preserving the required final reserve. Chinese TV interface.

entries.description: 旋转与镜像三角彩砖，让共享边同色并形成指定数量的红绿蓝色域；三关各有有限步数和90秒时限，每次操作都消耗一步，支持手机扫码单人操作。
entries.descriptionEn: Rotate and mirror triangular color tiles to match shared edges and exact red, green and blue region counts. Three original puzzles use charged moves and a 90-second limit; scan the TV code for single-player phone control. Chinese TV interface.

entries.description: 选择一行或一列，保持段内顺序压实数字石，不合并、不跨岩柱；蛇形读数严格递增且全部空洞吻合目标才能获胜，撤销恢复原石原格但不退已用步数或时间，手机扫码单人操作
entries.descriptionEn: Compact one selected row or column without merging or crossing fixed pillars. Keep physical stone order within each segment and achieve both a strictly increasing snake readout and the exact target holes. Undo restores stone positions without refunding successful moves or active time. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 环线果园
entries.description: 在格点之间铺设一条连通闭环，经过必经果树、避开禁水花坛并满足数字区域的边数提示；带编号管件可铺拆和精确撤销，剩余库存允许，须主动启动水泵，三次错误或90秒结束，手机扫码单人操作
entries.descriptionEn: Build one connected irrigation loop through required trees, avoid forbidden flower vertices, and satisfy exact region-edge clues; unhinted regions remain unconstrained. Place or remove unique physical pipes, undo the exact edit, then start PUMP explicitly. Three wrong starts or 90 active seconds end a round. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 邻接铸造
entries.description: 交换七格金属块，满足各自精确邻接配方并按固定方向优先级将热流导向铸模，再主动提交；三张固定布局、精确编号撤销与90秒有效时间，手机扫码单人操作
entries.descriptionEn: Swap unique metal tiles on seven hexagonal cells. Satisfy every exact local neighbor recipe and route heat from furnace to mold using fixed world-direction outlet priorities, then submit explicitly. Exact-ID undo, three wrong submissions and a 90-second active timer. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 双岛联结
entries.description: 按桥牌的直线长度与目标颜色连结岛屿，避开交叉并用尽所有独立桥牌组成连通网络；支持原片撤销，三关固定布局与90秒时限，手机扫码单人操作
entries.descriptionEn: Place unique bridge pieces between islands using exact straight-line lengths and matching destination colors. Use every piece to form one connected, noncrossing network; undo restores the same physical piece without refunding time or errors. Three fixed puzzles with a 90-second active timer. Chinese TV interface.

entries.name: 隐墙测绘
entries.description: 依据每行通路格数与最短边数，用有限探针推断4×4隐藏墙体，再提交安全且长度正确的路线；三关固定布局，支持手机扫码单人操作
entries.descriptionEn: Infer a hidden 4x4 wall map from public row counts, exact shortest edge distance and limited one-cell probes. Mark and submit a safe route of the required length. Three fixed puzzles with a 90-second active timer; three wrong submissions after probe exhaustion end a round. Chinese TV interface.
